purpose: Block over-claiming in AddressQL PostalValidationResult adapter outputs.

cases.blocked_claim: format pass proves that the address exists
cases.safe_replacement: A passing format check does not claim that the address exists.
A passing existence check does not prove delivery availability.
Delivery-related validation does not imply residence, ownership, legal identity, or recipient authorization.

cases.blocked_claim: identity relationship validation may disclose a full address
cases.safe_replacement: Identity-relationship validation must not disclose the full address in public fixtures.
